name: Censer of Controlling Air Elementals
summary: A censer that summons an Air Elemental under your control once a day.

stats.effect: While gently swinging this censer, you can take a {ref:glossary/magic} action to summon an **{ref:creature/air-elemental}**. The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the censer as possible, understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your {ref:glossary/initiative} count. The elemental disappears after 1 hour, when it dies, or when you dismiss it as a {ref:glossary/bonus-action}. The censer can't be used this way again until the next dawn.
